title: POUNCE MPCC benchmark result file
description: The gh#794 result contract. Every record stamps both repository commits, the model-data revision, the environment, the scaling and tolerances, the initial point and the configuration; and it keeps source-level quantities (feasibility, complementarity product, MPCC stationarity) strictly apart from POUNCE's own NLP/KKT diagnostics, because an MPCC lowering's NLP residuals are residuals of a different problem.

repositories.description: Both repository commits. discopt is recorded as absent-with-a-reason rather than omitted, so 'no comparison was run' is distinguishable from 'a comparison was run and not stamped'.

model_data_revision.description: SHA-256 prefix over spec.py, cases.py and lowering.py. Two result files with different revisions describe different benchmarks and must not be merged.

ccopt.description: The optional CCOpt integrated-continuation oracle: whether it was available, at what version, the pin a comparison would use, and whether a comparison was actually run.

config.description: Everything needed to reproduce the run: which cells were run, the pinned solver options, the relaxation schedule and the restart ladder.

start.description: Named initial point; the values are in the manifest.

control.description: Kill-switch control applied, 'none' for the plain configuration.

ok.description: The route ran to completion: every scheduled stage was accepted (after the restart ladder, if it was climbed). NOT 'a point came back' -- a continuation that accepts two stages and then fails still returns its best accepted point in `x`/`obj`, with accepted_stages/rejected_stages beside it, but is not ok.

status.description: POUNCE ApplicationReturnStatus of the last stage.

obj.description: Objective of the SOURCE model at the returned point.

source.description: See definitions/source_measured. Empty exactly when no point was returned.

stationarity.description: MPCC stationarity classification and the evidence behind it.

dual_scale.description: The magnitude of the largest term the stationarity sum is assembled from, including the terms inside grad f. The residual tolerance is this times 1e-6; an absolute threshold here would be a scale-dependent one, and the skew scaling leg breaks it.

validation.description: Source-level validation at the returned point: the benchmark class's own validator (validate.CLASS_VALIDATORS, one per class as gh#794 requires) plus any case-specific checks. Every entry is computed from the source MPCC -- no solver status, no NLP residual, no lowering. Keys ending in _ok are pass/fail; a failing one is a claim that the returned point is not the one the class describes, not automatically a defect (a local solver reaching a different local solution fails strict_complementarity_ok honestly). x_unscaled carries the returned point mapped back to the unscaled source model so the two scaling legs can be compared directly.

nlp.description: POUNCE's ordinary NLP/KKT diagnostics for the LOWERED problem, scaled and unscaled. Kept separate from the source block by design.

final_kkt_error.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

final_dual_inf.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

final_constr_viol.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

final_compl.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

final_unscaled_kkt_error.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

final_unscaled_dual_inf.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

final_unscaled_constr_viol.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

final_unscaled_compl.description: `null` where the value is not available -- a solve that returned no point has no residual to report.

iters.description: Total inner NLP iterations over all stages and restarts.

log_counters.description: Counters read off the iteration table. filter_resets is null because POUNCE emits no message for one: unmeasured, not zero.

stages.description: Per-stage detail: the relaxation parameter and why it moved, mu in and out and why, the warm-start and restart level, and whether the stage was accepted.

source_measured.description: Original-space quantities, computed from the source MPCC at the returned point. Never read off the lowered NLP. Present and fully populated exactly when `x` is non-null: a route that returned no point has nothing to measure, and an empty `source` beside a returned point would mean the original-space measurement silently did not happen.

row_viol.description: Max violation of the ordinary rows. Invariant under the scaling legs.

compl_max.description: Max |G_i H_i|: the source complementarity product. Not an NLP residual and not comparable against tol.

bound_viol.description: Max violation of the variable bounds. Scale-dependent by construction (lb - x becomes (lb - x)/d under the skew leg), so it is reported apart from row_viol rather than merged into it.
